summary: Frontend-only polish verification for Dashboard and Pre-Book Review. Login (empty fields, mocked) signed in as ryan@mirabile.com and landed on Dashboard. Dashboard: rv-account-row-lids expands rv-account-expand-lids showing exactly 5 metric tiles (OPEN PIPELINE $1,744,320, CONSERVATIVE LAND $4,460,373, FULL-YEAR FORECAST $4,460,373 +$1.5M vs goal, ANNUAL GOAL $3,000,000 target, PRIOR YEAR $4,683,724 YTD $3.4M · -20.1% YoY) plus rv-open-account-lids ('Open account') button — spacing looks clean in 1920 screenshot. Hero rv-goal-card renders 'ANNUAL GOAL' eyebrow with a ::before dot (content='""', bg rgb(227,154,28), 7x7px). Regression rv-seg-* (3), rv-range-* (3), rv-export-btn (1) all present. Pre-Book Review: pb-subtab-demand text is exactly 'SKU Demand\n12' — contains 'SKU Demand' and count '12' pill. pb-subtab-orders renders 4 pb-order-row-* rows with Units and Wholesale cells computed textAlign='right' (verified for both rows; SO# column shows '—' with textAlign='start', no overlap with numeric cols). Screenshots at 1920x1080 and 1280x900 both clean — document.body.scrollWidth == window.innerWidth at both widths (no horizontal scroll/overlap). Regression on Pre-Book: pb-drop-drop1/2/3 clickable; pb-preview-details expands; pb-actions-btn opens pb-actions-menu; Escape closes; pb-demand-* filters count = 4; 10 pb-sku-row-* rows, first expands into pb-sku-expand-* panel. Zero console errors and zero page errors captured during full run.
critical_code_review_comments: Order table uses div/role rather than semantic <th>/<td> (querySelectorAll('th') returned 0 while cells still expose correct computed textAlign). Consider semantic table markup for a11y even though visual alignment is correct.
Duplicate data-testid for pb-drop-drop1/2/3 and pb-show-archived still exist in hidden setup sidebar (carried over from iteration 38). Use scoped locators or render sidebar copies only in Setup mode.
